Security audit findings — 2026-08-21 code audit
[CRITICAL] owners.status directly client-writable — bypasses the death-activation state machine
[HIGH] Death declaration rate-limit/duplicate-pending checks are Express-only, bypassable via direct Supabase insert — duplicates can auto-confirm even after a successful contest
[MEDIUM-HIGH] vaults OTP rate-limit/lockout columns are "service-role-only" by convention only — owner can tamper with them directly via Supabase
[LOW] audit_logs INSERT policy has no ownership check — any authenticated user can forge accountability entries
[HIGH] Supabase session JWTs written to API logs on every authenticated request
[HIGH] Public rate limiters keyed on spoofable X-Forwarded-For — /support/contact is an open mail relay
[HIGH] Unhandled async rejection in auth.js/notifications.js can hang a request or crash the single API instance
[MEDIUM] Unescaped owner-controlled names injected into outbound transactional email HTML
[MEDIUM] Timing-unsafe string comparison for the Paytrail webhook HMAC signature
[MEDIUM] IP_HASH_SALT has a hardcoded fallback and is missing from env config — GDPR pseudonymization failure
[MEDIUM] POST /notifications/resend-invite has no rate limit and writes no audit_logs entry
[LOW] Invitation single-use check is check-then-update, not atomic (race condition)
[LOW] Paytrail success/cancel redirect URLs are not allowlisted — post-payment open redirect
[LOW] Public death-declaration contest endpoint leaks state before token verification, unthrottled
[LOW] Checklist deadline reminder resolves assigned_to without scoping to the owner — cross-owner notification leak
[LOW] Staleness-email unsubscribe token is static, non-expiring, and reuses the OTP HMAC secret
[HIGH] signOut() never locks the vault — master key persists in memory across account switch on a shared device
[MEDIUM] Representative vault view has no auto-lock and no manual lock button
[MEDIUM] GDPR account-data export writes vault key material to the downloaded file
[MEDIUM] vault_accounts.instruction stored as plaintext — contradicts vaultService.js's own comment claiming it's encrypted
[MEDIUM] Passphrase change in Settings leaves the vault unlocked app-wide with no auto-lock context
[MEDIUM] Representative escrow vault unlock is completely non-functional due to a destructuring bug
[LOW] Sentry scrub list omits genuinely plaintext vault field names (instruction, label, contact_name, etc.)
